onsetsample.Description: Onset time of the event relative to the EEG recording.

eventnumber.Description: Sequential number assigned to each event.

subjectnr.Description: Subject number associated with the recording.

blocksequencenumber.Description: Sequence number of the block in which the event occurred.

sequencenumber.Description: Sequence number of the event in the task.

presentationnumber.Description: Number representing the order of the event presentation.

stimpath.Description: Relative file path to the stimulus presented.

istarget.Description: Whether the event was a target stimulus.

time_stimon.Description: Time in seconds when the stimulus turned on, relative to the start of the EEG recording.

time_stimoff.Description: Time in seconds when the stimulus turned off, relative to the start of the EEG recording.
